The following words, terms, and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates a different meaning:

"Motorized Carts" or “carts” are defined as those electric and gasoline-powered pleasure carts, commonly referred to as golf carts, including low-speed motor vehicles. Low speed motor vehicle means any four-wheeled vehicle whose top speed in one mile is not greater than 25 miles per hour on a paved level surface and which is manufactured in compliance with those federal motor vehicle safety standards for lowspeed vehicles set forth in O.C.G.A. 40-1-1 (25.1). For the avoidance of doubt, Motorized Carts shall not include side-by-side UTVs, ATVs, or electric personal assistive mobility devices (EPAMD).

"Operator" is defined as the person driving and having physical control over the Motorized Cart.

"Permit Holder" is defined as the person who is the owner of the Motorized Cart and is the one in whose name the Motorized Cart is registered with the City of Barnesville.

"City" is defined as the City of Barnesville, GA.
4:
- (1) General. It shall be the duty of every owner of a Motorized Cart that is operated over the authorized streets, and those areas accessible by the public of the City, to register the cart with the City before any cart shall operate on the streets. Owners of such Motorized Carts shall have a grace period of sixty one (61) days from the date of the adoption of this Ordinance in order to register said Motorized Carts. Any owners operating Motorized Carts shall not be subject to fines under subsection (5) below during the sixty one (61) day grace period.

- (2) Permit required. No person shall operate a Motorized Cart that is not permitted through the City except as defined in the Reciprocal Agreement and the Exceptions described later in this article. For each Motorized Cart properly permitted through the City, the City shall issue the permit and provide a permit sticker. Permit stickers shall be affixed to rear of cart such that it is clearly visible.

- (3) Application. Every application for a permit should be made on a form supplied by the City and shall contain the following information:

Page 1 of 4

A. Name, address, and phone number of applicants/owners.

B. Model, make, name, and cart Manufacturer ID or Vehicle Identification Number or “VIN” number.

C. Valid driver's license number.

D. Proof of Liability insurance on the Motorized Cart for at least the minimum limits of $25,000/$50,000/$25,000 required by the State of GA for automobiles using public streets.

- (4) Equipment Required. Every Motorized Cart must have the following equipment to be eligible for a Permit with the City: Head Lamps; Tail Lamps; Brake Lights; Rearview Mirror; and a strobe light and/or light bar placed on either the top of, the roof of, or attached to the canopy of the Motorized Cart, but said strobe light(s) and/or light bar(s) shall not be in the color(s) of blue or red.

- (5) Penalties and Revocation of permit. If an Operator or Permit Holder is found to have violated any provision of Sec. 62-32.2 or Sec 62-32.3, or failure to otherwise abide by any and all local, state, and/or federal traffic laws in the use of a Motorized Cart, the following penalties shall apply:

A. For the first offense, a fine of not less than $100.00. B. For the second offense, a fine of not less than $150.00.

C. If a third offense is committed within one year of conviction for a second offense, the minimum fine shall be $250.00, and the Permit Holder's Motorized Cart permit shall be revoked. The registered owner cannot thereafter register a cart for use in the City for a period of two years following a third offense.

- (6) Transfer. Upon transferring the cart to another person who shall operate the cart over the authorized streets of the City, the registration must be transferred to the new owner within thirty (30) business days of the change in ownership at a cost of $20.00. If the registration is not transferred within thirty (30) business days, a $20.00 penalty will be applied in addition to the $20.00 registration charge, and the cart shall be considered an unregistered cart after the thirty (30) business day period.

- (7) Reciprocal Agreement. If a reciprocal agreement exists between the County of Lamar and the City of Barnesville, the City will honor/recognize permits issued by Lamar County. Residents of Lamar County and its other cities will be afforded the same privileges as those Permit Holders who are residents of the City, and all sections of this article will apply to the residents of Lamar County and its other cities as well. Notwithstanding anything contained herein to the contrary, the minimum age for operating a motorized cart in the City is 15 years old with a valid learners permit and with an adult person of at least 21 years of age present in the Motorized Cart.

- (8) Rental carts.

A. Cart dealers and distributors, as well as other commercial establishments, may rent Motorized Carts to the public for use on the authorized streets and those areas accessible by the public of the City. Each such established renting carts shall be required to register each such rental cart in accordance with subsections (1), (2), (3), and (4) of this section and shall maintain a written record of each person who rents each cart. Renters shall be required to furnish positive identification, shall be provided a copy of this article and must be at least 16 years of age. The registration fee and transfer fees and regulations shall be the same as those for other permit holders in the City.

B. Only those persons 18 years of age or older may register a Motorized Cart. Registration may be in one person's name only, and the registration form must be signed by that person, who is the owner of the Motorized Cart.
5:
- (1) Those persons who hold a valid motor vehicle driver's license, or a valid motor vehicle learner's permit, may operate a Motorized Cart on the authorized streets and those areas accessible by the public of the City. Notwithstanding anything contained herein to the contrary, the minimum age for operating a motorized cart in the City is 15 years old with a valid learners permit and with an adult person of at least 21 years of age present in the Motorized Cart.

- (2) All Operators shall abide by all traffic regulations applicable to vehicular traffic when using the streets and those areas accessible by the public of the City.

- (3) Motorized Carts may operate on streets and roadways within the City limits that have a posted maximum speed limit of 35 MPH.

- (4) Motorized Carts shall be operated on the right-hand side of the street(s) so as not to obstruct automobiles safe passage on the streets, including safely passing by Motorized Carts.
6: Nothing contained in the Code of Ordinances for the City of Barnesville, Georgia shall be construed as an assumption of liability by the City for any injuries to persons or property which may result from the operation of a Motorized Cart by a Permit Holder or the failure by the City to revoke said permit.
7:
- (1) The City of Barnesville shall be exempt from this ordinance.

- (2) This article is adopted pursuant to the City's police powers and shall be interpreted as applied so as not to conflict with general laws of the State of Georgia; where a conflict
